bot.help_text:
📖 *Mela Express Bot Help*

• /start — link your phone & open the menu
• /track CODE — track any parcel (or just paste a MEX code)
• /my_parcels — your active & past shipments
• /lang en or /lang am — message language
• 🔑 *Pickup code* — tap when status is Ready for Pickup
• 💳 *Pay* — Chapa checkout for pending fees

Tip: open the *Mini App* for live map, orders & payments.
